title: Automated review of pull requests by Claude, read-only
summary: A workflow that reviews every code pull request of a private repository once its CI is green: started by CI's end, it reads the diff from the default branch's tree with read tools only, and a job without Claude posts the verdict and fails the run unless it is a pass.

CI_WORKFLOW.prompt: Name of the CI workflow that must be green before a merge (its `name:`)

postInstall: For a PRIVATE repository only: read docs/conventions/claude-review.md first.
Add the repository secret CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN (from `claude setup-token`), unless the repository already has it.
Never run live by the kit's authors: open a throwaway pull request, read the run log and the comment, then one that should hold.
Fill CLAUDE.md § Conventions for new code: it is the review's checklist, and an empty one reviews against nothing of yours.
